def compile_mjcf(facts, out):
    rf=[(('crankshaft','rear_bearing'),'relation/rear_shaft_journal','fit/rear_bearing/journal/crankshaft/rear_journal','run'),(('crankshaft','front_bearing'),'relation/front_shaft_journal','fit/front_bearing/journal/crankshaft/front_journal','run'),(('crankshaft','crank_web'),'relation/shaft_to_crank_web','fit/crankshaft/crank_web_seat/crank_web/shaft_bore','press'),(('crank_web','crank_pin'),'relation/web_to_eccentric_pin','fit/crank_web/eccentric_bore/crank_pin/web_seat','press'),(('crank_pin','connecting_rod'),'relation/crank_pin_big_end','fit/crank_pin/rod_journal/connecting_rod/big_end','run'),(('crosshead','wrist_pin'),'relation/crosshead_to_wrist_pin','fit/crosshead/wrist_bore/wrist_pin/crosshead_seat','press'),(('wrist_pin','connecting_rod'),'relation/wrist_pin_small_end','fit/wrist_pin/rod_journal/connecting_rod/small_end','run'),(('crosshead','pump_rod'),'relation/crosshead_carries_pump_rod','fit/crosshead/pump_rod_socket/pump_rod/crosshead_seat','press'),(('pump_rod','pump_piston'),'relation/pump_rod_carries_piston','fit/pump_rod/piston_seat/pump_piston/rod_bore','press'),(('crankshaft','hand_crank_arm'),'relation/shaft_to_hand_arm','fit/crankshaft/hand_arm_seat/hand_crank_arm/shaft_bore','press'),(('hand_crank_arm','handle_pin'),'relation/arm_to_handle_pin','fit/hand_crank_arm/handle_bore/handle_pin/arm_seat','press'),(('handle_pin','hand_grip'),'relation/handle_pin_to_grip','fit/handle_pin/grip_journal/hand_grip/pin_bore','run')]
    ps=[('crankshaft','rear_bearing'),('crankshaft','front_bearing'),('crankshaft','crank_web'),('crankshaft','connecting_rod'),('crankshaft','hand_crank_arm'),('crankshaft','rear_pedestal'),('crankshaft','front_pedestal'),('crankshaft','crank_pin'),('crankshaft','left_guide_rail'),('crankshaft','right_guide_rail'),('crankshaft','handle_pin'),('crankshaft','hand_grip'),('crankshaft','crosshead'),('crankshaft','wrist_pin'),('crankshaft','bench_base'),('crankshaft','pump_rod'),('crank_web','crank_pin'),('crank_web','front_bearing'),('crank_web','connecting_rod'),('crank_web','front_pedestal'),('crank_web','right_guide_rail'),('crank_web','left_guide_rail'),('crank_pin','connecting_rod'),('crank_pin','right_guide_rail'),('crank_pin','front_bearing'),('crank_pin','front_pedestal'),('connecting_rod','crosshead'),('connecting_rod','wrist_pin'),('connecting_rod','pump_rod'),('connecting_rod','front_pedestal'),('connecting_rod','right_guide_rail'),('connecting_rod','left_guide_rail'),('connecting_rod','front_bearing'),('connecting_rod','cylinder_lower_frame'),('connecting_rod','cylinder_right_post'),('connecting_rod','cylinder_left_post'),('connecting_rod','bench_base'),('crosshead','wrist_pin'),('crosshead','left_guide_rail'),('crosshead','right_guide_rail'),('crosshead','pump_rod'),('crosshead','cylinder_lower_frame'),('wrist_pin','pump_rod'),('wrist_pin','left_guide_rail'),('wrist_pin','right_guide_rail'),('pump_rod','pump_piston'),('pump_rod','cylinder_lower_frame'),('pump_rod','cylinder_left_post'),('pump_rod','cylinder_right_post'),('pump_rod','left_guide_rail'),('pump_rod','right_guide_rail'),('pump_piston','cylinder_left_post'),('pump_piston','cylinder_right_post'),('pump_piston','cylinder_lower_frame'),('hand_crank_arm','handle_pin'),('hand_crank_arm','hand_grip'),('hand_crank_arm','rear_pedestal'),('hand_crank_arm','rear_bearing'),('handle_pin','hand_grip'),('handle_pin','rear_pedestal'),('handle_pin','rear_bearing')]
    keep=[('connecting_rod','crankshaft'),('connecting_rod','crank_web'),('crosshead','left_guide_rail'),('crosshead','right_guide_rail')]
    cds=[]; ex=[]
    for a,b in ps:
        k=tuple(sorted((a,b))); q=None
        for z,rel,fit,typ in rf:
            if tuple(sorted(z))==k: q=(rel,fit,typ)
        if k in keep:
            ac='keep'; r='Keep functional guide contact or rod collision against the shared crank carrier/web.'; s=['link/'+a,'link/'+b]; f=['pair/'+k[0]+'/'+k[1]]
        else:
            ac='exclude'; s=['link/'+a,'link/'+b]; f=['pair/'+k[0]+'/'+k[1]]; r='Positive real-mesh separation or disjoint AABB extent makes this exact pair a collision-proxy false-contact risk.'
            if q:
                s=[q[0],'link/'+a,'link/'+b]; f=[q[1],'pair/'+k[0]+'/'+k[1]]; r=('Nonnegative-clearance running fit is represented by an ideal hinge; exclude only this exact bearing pair.' if q[2]=='run' else 'Negative-clearance press fit is rigidly carried; exclude only this exact fitted pair.')
            ex.append((a,b,r,s,f))
        cds.append({'pair':[a,b],'action':ac,'reason':r,'source_entity_ids':s,'fact_ids':f})
    cm={'crankshaft':'crankshaft_revolute','crank_web':'crankshaft_revolute','crank_pin':'crankshaft_revolute','connecting_rod':'connecting_rod_big_end','crosshead':'crosshead_vertical_slide','wrist_pin':'crosshead_vertical_slide','pump_rod':'crosshead_vertical_slide','pump_piston':'crosshead_vertical_slide','hand_crank_arm':'crankshaft_revolute','handle_pin':'crankshaft_revolute','hand_grip':'hand_grip_revolute'}
    out.topology_plan({'coordinate_map':cm,'tree_edges':[['bench_base','crankshaft'],['crankshaft','crank_web'],['crank_web','crank_pin'],['crank_pin','connecting_rod'],['bench_base','crosshead'],['crosshead','wrist_pin'],['crosshead','pump_rod'],['pump_rod','pump_piston'],['crankshaft','hand_crank_arm'],['hand_crank_arm','handle_pin'],['handle_pin','hand_grip']], 'closure_edges':[['connecting_rod','wrist_pin','wrist_pin_small_end_connect']], 'rigid_carried':[['crankshaft','crank_web'],['crank_web','crank_pin'],['crosshead','wrist_pin'],['crosshead','pump_rod'],['pump_rod','pump_piston'],['crankshaft','hand_crank_arm'],['hand_crank_arm','handle_pin']], 'independent_coaxial':[['rear_bearing','crankshaft'],['front_bearing','crankshaft'],['crank_pin','connecting_rod'],['wrist_pin','connecting_rod'],['handle_pin','hand_grip']], 'transmissions':[{'name':'shaft_rigidly_carries_crank_web','ratio':1.0,'strategy':'rigid_tree'},{'name':'crank_web_rigidly_carries_eccentric_pin','ratio':1.0,'strategy':'rigid_tree'},{'name':'shaft_rigidly_carries_hand_arm','ratio':1.0,'strategy':'rigid_tree'}], 'contact_decisions':cds,'support_ground':'global ground retained; bench_base is structural support','support_strategy':'fixed normal support tree; no support patch required'})
    tree=[('bench_base',''),('rear_pedestal','bench_base'),('rear_bearing','rear_pedestal'),('front_pedestal','bench_base'),('front_bearing','front_pedestal'),('left_guide_rail','bench_base'),('right_guide_rail','bench_base'),('cylinder_lower_frame','left_guide_rail'),('cylinder_left_post','cylinder_lower_frame'),('cylinder_right_post','cylinder_lower_frame'),('cylinder_upper_frame','cylinder_left_post'),('crankshaft','bench_base'),('crank_web','crankshaft'),('crank_pin','crank_web'),('connecting_rod','crank_pin'),('crosshead','bench_base'),('wrist_pin','crosshead'),('pump_rod','crosshead'),('pump_piston','pump_rod'),('hand_crank_arm','crankshaft'),('handle_pin','hand_crank_arm'),('hand_grip','handle_pin')]
    for b,p in tree: out.body(b,p)
    out.joint('crankshaft','crankshaft_revolute','hinge',(0,1,0),(0,0,30),'world')
    out.joint('connecting_rod','connecting_rod_big_end','hinge',(0,1,0),(10,25,30),'world')
    out.joint('crosshead','crosshead_vertical_slide','slide',(0,0,1),(0,0,5),'world')
    out.joint('hand_grip','hand_grip_revolute','hinge',(0,1,0),(-14,-36,30),'world')
    out.connect('wrist_pin_small_end_connect','connecting_rod','wrist_pin',(0,0.025,0.056),'Non-tree small-end pin closes the slider-crank at its measured world anchor.',['relation/wrist_pin_small_end','port/wrist_pin/rod_journal','port/connecting_rod/small_end'],['fit/wrist_pin/rod_journal/connecting_rod/small_end','pair/connecting_rod/wrist_pin'])
    for a,b,r,s,f in ex: out.exclude(a,b,r,s,f)
    for e in facts['entity_ids']:
        ac='represented_by'; nodes=['bench_base']; r='Authored fact consumed by topology, fit classification, placement, role mapping, or contact review.'
        if e.startswith('link/'): ac='emitted'; nodes=[e[5:]]; r='Link emitted exactly once.'
        elif e=='motion_joint/crankshaft_revolute': ac='emitted'; nodes=['crankshaft_revolute']; r='Authored shaft hinge emitted in world frame.'
        elif e=='motion_joint/crosshead_vertical_slide': ac='emitted'; nodes=['crosshead_vertical_slide']; r='Authored crosshead slide emitted in world frame.'
        elif e=='relation/crank_pin_big_end': nodes=['connecting_rod_big_end']; r='Big-end running fit is the rod tree hinge.'
        elif e=='relation/wrist_pin_small_end': nodes=['wrist_pin_small_end_connect']; r='Small-end revolute is the non-tree point closure.'
        elif e=='relation/handle_pin_to_grip': nodes=['hand_grip_revolute']; r='Grip running fit has an independent hinge.'
        elif e.startswith('role/driver/') or e.startswith('role/watch/crankshaft') or e.startswith('transmission/shaft_'): nodes=['crankshaft_revolute']
        elif e.startswith('role/output/') or e.startswith('role/watch/'): nodes=['crosshead_vertical_slide']
        out.decision(e,ac,nodes,r,[e])
